title: Do Bumble Bees Play with Toys?
source: Original primer for Margin · Galpayage Dona et al., Animal Behaviour (2022), doi:10.1016/j.anbehav.2022.08.013.

sentences: Could an insect play with a toy?
In a 2022 study, bumble bees repeatedly rolled small wooden balls without getting food for doing it.
The bees could walk straight to a feeding area along a clear path.
They could also take a detour into areas containing balls.
The balls were not blocking their route.
Some returned to roll balls on several days, and one rolled them 117 times over the experiment.
Younger bees rolled more than older bees.
A second experiment used two differently coloured chambers.
One contained movable balls during training; the other had no objects.
Later, with both chambers empty, bees preferred the colour associated with the balls.
The team checked whether rolling was a way to search for food, clear obstacles or attempt mating.
Their observations supported an interpretation of object play under established behavioural criteria.
This does not directly reveal what a bee feels.
A preference suggests that rolling was rewarding, but it cannot tell us whether that experience feels like human happiness.
A toy offers a small window into an animal’s behaviour.
Even an insect may do more than the work needed to get through the day.

steps.say: 今晚想跟你讲讲熊蜂玩球的实验。研究者发现这些毛茸茸的小昆虫会反复滚动木球，即使这样做得不到食物奖励。
实验里有条直通食物的路，熊蜂沿着它走就能吃到东西，可它们经常主动绕到旁边去滚那些没有挡路的小木球。
研究者跟踪了四十五只熊蜂，发现有些会连续几天回来滚球，其中有只熊蜂在整个实验期间滚了一百一十七次。
他们还发现年轻的熊蜂比年纪大的滚得更多。
为了看看滚球本身是否能吸引熊蜂，研究者让它们进入颜色不同的两间小房间，并只在其中一间放了能滚动的球。
后来他们把球拿走，熊蜂依然更喜欢之前有球的那种颜色，尽管那间房已经没有什么可玩了。
团队还检查了滚球是否与觅食或求偶有关，并通过实验设计排除了清理障碍的需要。综合这些观察，他们认为滚球符合动物行为学中判断玩耍的标准。
steps.note: object play 玩弄物体的游戏行为

steps.say: 这让人很想知道熊蜂玩球的时候会不会开心，不过实验目前能告诉我们的是它们愿意反复滚球，还会偏向曾经有球的地方，至于那种感受和人的快乐有多像，我们还没有直接的证据。
